d: AirMedia® Receiver 3200 with Wi-Fi® Network Connectivity, International

specs.label: Ethernet
specs.value: 100/1000 Mbps, auto-switching, autonegotiating, autodiscovery, full/half duplex, TCP/IP, UDP/IP, DHCP, SSL, TLS, SSH, SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol), IEEE 802.1x, Active Directory authentication

specs.label: Wi-Fi
specs.value: Dual-band 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax (2.4 GHz & 5 GHz); Up to 100 ft (30 m) range at 80 Mbps, subject to site-specific conditions

specs.label: AirMedia
specs.value: Via Ethernet: IPv4, mDNS, TLS, AES; Via wireless access point: IEEE 802.11/b/g/n/ac/ax, 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz

specs.label: USB Host
specs.value: USB 2.0 for connecting a USB conferencing peripheral; USB 3.0 for connecting a USB conferencing peripheral

specs.label: USB Device
specs.value: USB 3.0 for computer console (installer setup and firmware update)

specs.label: RS-232
specs.value: 2-way display device control up to 115.2k baud with hardware and software handshaking

specs.label: IR/Serial
specs.value: 1-way display device control via infrared up to 1.1 MHz or serial TTL/RS-232 (0-5V) up to 19.2k baud

specs.label: HDMI Input
specs.value: HDCP 1.4, EDID; Supports management of HDCP and EDID

specs.label: HDMI Output
specs.value: HDCP 2.2, EDID, CEC; Supports management of HDCP and EDID

specs.label: Input Signal Types
specs.value: AirMedia, HDMI (DVI & Dual-Mode DisplayPort™ compatible); Supports simultaneous display of up to four sources with AirMedia Canvas when presenting using the AirMedia Applications

specs.label: Maximum Input Resolutions
specs.value: HDMI Input: 1920x1080@60Hz (HD 1080p60); AirMedia presentation: 1920x1080@30Hz (1080p30); AirMedia Connect Adapter: 3840x2160@30Hz (4K30)
